title: 콧소리 되기 2: 입니다, 갑니다, 몇 년
objective: By the end, you can read words like 입니다, 갑니다 and 몇 년 aloud correctly. You will change a ㄷ-sound final consonant to [ㄴ] and a ㅂ-sound final consonant to [ㅁ] when ㄴ or ㅁ comes next.
summary: Learn why 입니다 sounds like [임니다] and 몇 년 sounds like [면년]: ㄷ and ㅂ final consonants become ㄴ and ㅁ before ㄴ or ㅁ.

task.title: Read and write the sounds
task.line: Look at the final consonant and the next letter, then choose or write the real sound.

words.exampleMeaning: I am going to Busan tomorrow.
How many years did you live in Korea?
What time does the class finish?
Please get on at the front door.

letters.as: Close your lips as for 'b', then hum: 'm' as in 'mom'.
Tongue up as for 'd', then hum: 'n' as in 'no'.
These end like a short 't'; before n or m, they become 'n'.
ㅍ ends like a short 'p'; before n or m, it becomes 'm'.

exercises: Choose the correct sound: ① 합니다 (a) [합니다] (b) [함니다] ② 첫눈 (a) [천눈] (b) [첟눈] ③ 밥만 (a) [밤만] (b) [바만]
Write how it sounds in [ ]: ① 십 년 ② 꽃만 ③ 낱말
Does the final consonant change to [ㄴ] or [ㅁ]? Write Yes or No: ① 맞나요 ② 집도 ③ 빗물
Which sound does the final consonant become? Write ㄴ or ㅁ: ① 앞날 ② 닫는 ③ 몇 명
Write the sound of the last word in [ ]: ① 아기가 잡니다. ② 지금 문을 닫나요? ③ 빵을 굽니다.
answers: ① Yes [만나요] ② No ③ Yes [빈물]
① ㅁ [암날] ② ㄴ [단는] ③ ㄴ [면명]
